title: The Ten Commandments of God
lines: Peace be with you, brothers and sisters. Welcome to all who have gathered here to pray together.
God gave His people the Ten Commandments as a lamp to light the path of life.
The first: worship the one true God and love Him above all things.
The second: do not take the name of the Lord your God in vain.
The third: keep holy the Lord's Day.
The fourth: honor your father and your mother.
The fifth: you shall not kill.
The sixth and the ninth: keep your heart pure and be faithful in love.
The seventh and the tenth: do not steal, and do not covet what belongs to another.
The eighth: do not bear false witness.
All ten are summed up in two: love God above all things, and love your neighbor as yourself.

title: The Beatitudes
lines: On the mountain, Jesus opened His mouth and taught the people the way to true happiness.
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
Blessed are those persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
May each of us live these Beatitudes in every ordinary day.

title: The Our Father
lines: Jesus taught His disciples to pray with the words we still pray every day.
Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread.
And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.
And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.
Each time we pray it, we learn to place our lives in the hands of our loving Father.

title: The Return of the Prodigal Son
lines: Jesus told a parable about a father who had two sons.
The younger son asked for his share of the inheritance, left home, and wasted everything he had.
When hunger struck, he came to his senses and said: I will get up and go back to my father.
While he was still far off, his father saw him, was filled with compassion, ran to him and embraced him.
The father did not scold him, but dressed him in the best robe, put a ring on his finger, and threw a feast.
God is that kind of Father, always waiting for us and ready to forgive.
No matter how far we have wandered, the door of the Father's house is always open.

title: Charity — The Hymn of Love
lines: Saint Paul wrote some of the most beautiful words ever written about love.
Love is patient, love is kind.
Love does not envy, does not boast, is not proud.
Love does no wrong, does not seek its own, is not easily angered, and keeps no record of wrongs.
Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
Now faith, hope, and love remain, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
May our families always be built on that kind of love.

title: The Good Samaritan
lines: Someone asked Jesus: who is my neighbor?
Jesus told of a man who was beaten by robbers and left half dead by the roadside.
A priest and a Levite came by, but each one passed by on the other side.
Then a Samaritan came along, was moved with pity, bandaged his wounds, and took him to an inn to care for him.
Jesus asked: which of these three was a neighbor to the man who fell among robbers?
The one who showed him mercy. And Jesus said: go and do likewise.
Our neighbor is whoever needs our help today.

title: Mercy and Forgiveness
lines: Peter asked the Lord: should I forgive my brother as many as seven times?
Jesus answered: not seven times, but seventy times seven.
Forgiving does not mean forgetting; it means choosing love over resentment.
When we forgive, our own heart is set free and peace returns.
God has forgiven us so many times, so let us also forgive one another.
Lord, give us a heart gentle and humble like Your own.

title: Do Not Worry
lines: Jesus said: look at the birds of the air; they neither sow nor reap, yet your heavenly Father feeds them.
Consider the lilies of the field; they do not toil, yet they are clothed more beautifully than Solomon in all his glory.
How much more precious are you than the birds and the flowers.
So do not be anxious about tomorrow; tomorrow will take care of itself.
Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness.
And all these other things will be given to you as well.
Hand your burdens over to the Lord, and He will hold you up.

title: The Lord Is the Good Shepherd
lines: Jesus said: I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
My sheep hear my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
Which of you, having a hundred sheep and losing one, would not leave the ninety-nine to go after the one that is lost?
And when he finds it, he joyfully lays it on his shoulders and calls his friends to rejoice with him.
In the same way there is joy in heaven over one sinner who repents.
Even if you have lost your way, the Lord is out looking for you.

title: The Power of Prayer
lines: Jesus taught: ask and it will be given to you, seek and you will find, knock and the door will be opened.
What father, when his child asks for bread, would hand him a stone?
How much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him.
Prayer is talking with God, the way a little child talks with their parents.
You need no fancy words, only a sincere and trusting heart.
Every morning when you wake and every night before you sleep, give God a few quiet minutes.

title: The Family — The Church at Home
lines: The family is the first place where we learn to love and to forgive.
The Holy Family of Nazareth, Jesus, Mary, and Joseph, is the model for every family.
Parents, love and guide your children with patience and good example.
Children, honor your father and mother, for that is the commandment that comes with a promise.
Husbands and wives, love one another as Christ loves the Church.
The family that prays together stays together.
May God bless every family watching this time of prayer today.

title: Mary — Our Mother
lines: When the angel brought the message, Mary answered: behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it done unto me according to thy word.
She is the model of faith, humility, and obedience.
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.
In every trouble, run to our Mother; she always leads us to Jesus.

title: The Light of the World
lines: Jesus said: you are the salt of the earth, you are the light of the world.
No one lights a lamp and puts it under a basket, but on a stand, so it gives light to everyone in the house.
Let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works.
A kind word, a smile, a helping hand, all of these are light.
Today, you can be a light for someone who is hurting.

title: Hope Does Not Disappoint
lines: There are times when life feels like a dark night, but after the night there is always a dawn.
Jesus suffered and died, but on the third day He rose again.
The Resurrection tells us that love is stronger than death, and light is stronger than darkness.
Do not be afraid, for I am with you always, even to the end of the age.
Hold on to hope, for God never abandons His children.

title: The Mustard Seed and the Yeast
lines: Jesus compared the kingdom of heaven to a mustard seed, the smallest of all seeds.
Yet when it grows, it becomes a great tree, and the birds of the air come and nest in its branches.
The kingdom of heaven is also like yeast that a woman mixed into three measures of flour until all of it was leavened.
The small good deeds of each day, God will make them grow.
Never look down on a small prayer or a small act done with love.

title: Gratitude
lines: Ten lepers were healed by Jesus, but only one came back to give thanks.
Jesus asked: were not all ten made clean? Where are the other nine?
Gratitude makes our joy complete.
Thank God for every breath, for your family, for your daily meals, and for the people who love you.
In all circumstances give thanks, for this is the will of God.
Thanks be to God for bringing us together in prayer today.
